p: Abishalom: Some think that this was Absalom Solomon's son.
lamp in Jerusalem: Meaning, a son to reign over Judah.
mother's name was Maachah: That is, his grandmother, as David is often called the father of those who are his grandchildren.
removed from being queen: Neither kindred nor authority should be regarded when they blaspheme God and become idolaters, but must be punished.
perfect with the LORD all his: Though he permitted them to worship God in other places than he had appointed it came from ignorance, and not from malice.
Ramah: For the same reason that Jeroboam did, because the people should not go up to Jerusalem, least they follow Asa.
depart from me: And vex me no longer.
feet: He had gout and put his trust physicians rather than in the Lord, 2Ch 16:12.
smote all the house of Jeroboam: So God stirred up one tyrant to punish the wickedness of another.
provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD: By causing the people to commit idolatry with his calves, and so provoking God to anger.
Tirzah: Which was the place where the kings of Israel remained.
